label: RokuRoku-66 / Six independent serpentine limbs
missing_damage_states_reason: D1–D3 not authored; damage is independent of LOD.

lod_selection.distance: Static extended silhouette. Use LOD1 before articulating limbs.

runtime.cables: Two-bone blended slack loops near the joint centre; visual flexibility, not an inextensible cable simulation.
runtime.scope: Joint-driven curvature and planar planted-tip locomotion. Pole is a separate viewer fixture. No force-based grasping, terrain adaptation or general collision response.

locomotion.world_motion: Translate an outer parent by speed_m_s times continuous time; do not wrap travel at clip boundaries.
locomotion.scope: Planar planted-tip kinematics; body-origin support polygon, not force or mass simulation.

behavior.world_motion: Controller owns position, heading and world contact targets. Place an outer actor, update its world matrices, then applyBehaviorPose. Do not add gait travel a second time.
behavior.scope: Four support limbs, two sensors; one-foot crawl and diagonal-pair rush. Planar kinematics, no force or obstacle solver.

story.name: 09TAI_Field_Encounter

chapters.title: Sleeping spiral
chapters.description: Six curled limbs. A small visitor approaches.

chapters.title: Something nearby
chapters.description: Uncoil, stretch and lift into a standing posture.

chapters.title: First steps
chapters.description: Follow the rolling visitor at a tentative walking pace.

chapters.title: Where did it go?
chapters.description: Pause, test the ground and listen.

chapters.title: A signal ahead
chapters.description: Raise the body; both feelers search toward 09-tai.

chapters.title: Found you
chapters.description: Lower the body as the lure begins to escape.

chapters.title: The first pursuit
chapters.description: A double-speed rush, steered toward the moving lure.

chapters.title: Almost close enough
chapters.description: Brake, rebound and let the visitor draw ahead.

chapters.title: Keep it in sight
chapters.description: Resume a deliberate walk with searching feelers.

chapters.title: A long stretch
chapters.description: Spread all six limbs before drawing them inward.

chapters.title: A curious curl
chapters.description: Coil into a spiral, then reopen and rise.

chapters.title: Another discovery
chapters.description: A pole catches RokuRoku’s attention.

chapters.title: Feel the surface
chapters.description: Settle beside the fixed pole and reach toward it.

chapters.title: Around the pole
chapters.description: One limb winds upward around the pole.

chapters.title: A moment of stillness
chapters.description: Hold the coil while 09-tai waits nearby.

chapters.title: Let go
chapters.description: Unwind the same limb without moving the pole.

chapters.title: Back to the visitor
chapters.description: Replant, lift the feelers and walk away.

chapters.title: There it is again
chapters.description: Stop and track the lure as it picks up speed.

chapters.title: One more try
chapters.description: Gather low for another burst.

chapters.title: The second pursuit
chapters.description: Chase the live lure at twice the normal rush speed.

chapters.title: The visitor wins this round
chapters.description: Ease down into a walk, then a quiet stop.

chapters.title: Still curious
chapters.description: Keep breathing and watching. The encounter settles.

story.world_motion: Place an outer actor from the story frame, update its world matrices, then applyStoryPose. Place a separate 09-tai carrier with its GLB scene offset by -0.8 m in Y and call applyStoryLure. The pole stays fixed at story.pole.
story.scope: Authored chapter order with reactive lure pacing and pursuit steering. Planar kinematics, world contact locking during locomotion; authored whole-body morphs temporarily release contacts. No force-based grip or general obstacle solver.
